condition: Drop one or more supported documents onto the entry surface and create or select the correct case without asking for analytical fields
notes: POST /api/intake takes files only: the golden test asserts the case is created with the issuer derived from the documents ('never typed'); the membership test asserts an unambiguous own case for the same normalized issuer is resolved rather than duplicated and a foreign member's case is never joined. The three-engine smoke (workbench-smoke.mjs L596-612) drops packs on the real 'Analyze documents' drop zone and asserts the panel has no pathway picker (#pathway count 0) and no combobox before submitting with Enter.

condition: Derive issuer, reporting period, document type, and candidate objective from evidence, then show the derivation and confidence for review
notes: Golden test asserts issuer + issuer_confidence (high/medium) + basis host_classification, per-document document_type and period (FY2024, FY2025-Q3), coverage, and route {pathway, depth, selected_by, reason}; every document row carries the pinned keys confidence and signals; the route-selection cases assert route.reason names the deciding word and route.evidence is non-empty. Smoke L613-621 waits for the 'Source disposition manifest' region listing every document and the 'selected by host classification' label on screen.

condition: Default to the governed Full Credit route when no narrower objective is safely supported
notes: A mixed pack (annual + quarterly + credit agreement) routes to FULL_CREDIT/full; a document instructing DEEP_RESEARCH at screen depth still yields FULL_CREDIT/full; a textless-only pack proposes FULL_CREDIT. Narrower routes are selected only when the pack proves them (the five other route cases).

condition: Ask only a blocking clarification that cannot be answered from the supplied documents
notes: The only clarification the intake ever returns is the typed INTAKE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT with a next_action, raised when no admitted document carries quotable evidence (status 'clarification', run None); a pack that answers everything starts with no question asked. Smoke L599-600 asserts the intake panel offers no analytical choice (zero comboboxes, no #pathway).

condition: Never ask the analyst to retype a number, table, source locator, or fact already present in evidence
notes: Issuer, periods, types and coverage are read from the documents (asserted 'never typed'); recovery after a textless-only pack takes only the missing file and re-enters nothing; the Deep Research brief is itself a supplied file whose question is read back from the run. Smoke L599-600 asserts the surface asks for nothing but files. Weak point: this is a universal negative and the evidence covers the document-first surface only; the advanced compile form (research question, focus questions) asks for analyst context that is not in evidence, which the condition permits.

condition: Automatically inventory, scan, extract, deduplicate, version, and freeze the source set
notes: Inventory = the documents manifest (one row per file with disposition); scan = the EICAR member refuses the pack; extract = every admitted document carries blocks (30-document corpus run); dedupe = exact duplicate collapses to one source id with both names; version = one source-set version per pack, v2 on the redrop; freeze = run.plan.source_set_id equals the current set and the gate pin never moves with later uploads.

condition: Automatically compile and start the route after the source gate passes
notes: Intake status 'started', run.plan pinned to the admitted set and case.current_execution_id set in the same response; the host-control run then completes with every node succeeded. Smoke L610-611 waits for '... selected by host classification. Execution started.' after the drop.

condition: Pause with one actionable missing-evidence message when the source gate fails
notes: Insufficient evidence yields exactly one typed refusal {code INTAKE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, next_action} with run None and the scan still admitted; the run gate itself pauses without pinning on an empty set and re-pauses on resume. The a11y sweep scans the 'refusal' state on screen; smoke L644-656 shows the refused pack's 'Documents not admitted' alert naming the offending file.

condition: Resume automatically after the missing document arrives, without recreating the case or route
notes: Dropping the missing annual into the same case_id returns status 'started' on FULL_CREDIT with source-set v2 still holding the scan (same case, same route, new run started automatically); GET /cases/{id}/intake serves the latest intake. Restart test proves the intake and run are durable.

condition: Open the completed analytical review when the run succeeds
notes: Smoke L626-635: after the host-control run completes, the intake panel offers 'Open review', which lands on /run-console/ for that case showing 'Run status: succeeded' and the 'Accept analytical snapshot' control, with accepted_snapshot_id still null on the wire. Backend test pins that completion never accepts on the analyst's behalf.

condition: Present facts, machine analysis, analyst edits, analyst opinion, limitations, and approval state as distinct content
notes: Smoke L2015-2032 asserts the frozen paper renders 'Accepted Analysis' (facts/machine output, locked), 'Analyst Snapshot' (analyst edit), 'Analyst Opinion', 'Opinion Sign-Off' rows (Limitations, Signed by, Approval state PENDING APPROVAL) and 'Control Status' as separate sections; unit tests 'only analyst-owned editable text can be overlaid by draft blocks' and 'the structured document is safe and keeps generated content read-only'. Caveat: the Report Studio half of the smoke runs against route-mocked fixtures; the real payload composition is proven by the backend tests cited.

condition: Expose no LLM/provider picker in the enterprise MVP; preserve signed financial-model selection, scenario, revision, and sign-off controls
notes: Second half proven: model selection/preview/sign-off, scenario registry, revision and opinion sign-off are driven in the smoke (L1128-1270, L1967-2010) and unit tests ('model sign-off is one ordered approval sequence', 'Scenario registry is build-bound', 'the opinion is signed on the exact saved revision'). Add one absent-control assertion (e.g. no combobox naming provider/model on cases, run-console, model-builder, report-studio).

condition: Preserve the same workflow and controls for every qualified model choice
owner: enterprise test owner (live credential) / model risk
notes: The route is a pure function of (pathway, depth) independent of provider, and the same workflow completes under the answer-keyed host-control binding on every route at both depths. Only one qualified live binding can exist (exact Anthropic pair) and it is BLOCKED EXTERNAL, so no second 'qualified model choice' has been exercised; nothing here compares controls across live models.

condition: Protect unsaved analyst edits during navigation, refresh, reconnect, and browser history changes
notes: Smoke L1300-1400: dirty Model Builder draft blocks case switch, internal link, command-palette navigation and window.history.back() with the 'Discard draft changes?' dialog; cancel restores URL, value (0.06) and focus; confirm traverses exactly one history boundary. notes: Analyst signs the opinion on the exact saved revision (smoke L1967-2010 fills Rationale etc. and asserts the frozen record binds the signer); filing is refused for analysts (403) and for the signer/freeze actor (APPROVER_NOT_INDEPENDENT); smoke L2034-2042 and unit 'the opinion signer and the freeze actor never see a File control for their own output' prove the File control is absent for them.

condition: Complete the golden journey with keyboard-only operation

REV-010 (manual keyboard-only over every destination and state) is OUTSTANDING.

notes: Partial: the journey completes at 1440x1000 (smoke) and the a11y sweep scans 9 routes at 1280/1366/1440/1600/1920 and 720 (1440 at 200% zoom) with 0 violations including page-horizontal-scroll; after each smoke stage the page is re-checked at 720 for overflow (intake manifest L636-639, Model Builder, Report Studio, Sources, Deep-Dive). condition: Surface typed failures without raw provider, database, secret, stack, or rejected-input content
notes: Provider error bodies (secret token, redirect host) never persisted; DB outage is {code: STORE_UNAVAILABLE} with no driver text; run error is {code, module_id} only; rejected surrogate input is not echoed by the validation handler; secrets redacted and worker exceptions logged by class only; provider absence is the typed AGENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE on the intake wire. Frontend unit tests 'api never serves a raw object or validation detail as its message' and 'a server code is never presented as a raw identifier'.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Accept every declared supported type with valid evidence
notes: Declared types are pdf, xlsx, json, txt, md, csv (ALLOWED_SUFFIXES). Acceptance is proven for pdf, xlsx, json and txt; no retained passed test admits a valid .md or .csv source (both appear only in rejection tests: evidence-free and non-UTF-8). Add one acceptance case each for .md and .csv.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject an unsupported extension, media type, signature, or extension-content mismatch
notes: Proven: unsupported extension is 415 at the helper, the source route and the intake; .pdf/.xlsx suffixes with non-PDF/non-workbook bytes are refused by the parser (422). Not proven and not implemented: admission keys on the filename suffix only, the client media type is stored unverified (SPEC_RECONCILIATION 'Filename and media type are not BoundaryText') and no byte-signature sniff exists, so a media-type mismatch or a text file carrying another format's signature is not refused.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject zero-byte and evidence-free files before any source or source-set mutation
notes: assert_rejected asserts 422 and that the current source set is unchanged after the refusal (no source, no set delta); the intake refuses the whole pack with no case and only an intake.refused audit row, and an existing case's set stays byte-identical.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject invalid UTF-8, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite JSON values, and over-range numbers
notes: Invalid UTF-8 in txt/md/csv, duplicate keys at top level and nested, NaN/Infinity/-Infinity and over-range 1e999/-1e999 are all 422 with no source-set delta.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Preserve finite zero, false, blank optional cells, signs, units, currencies, periods, entities, and definitions
notes: Proven: finite zero and false are admitted as JSON sources; blank optional workbook cells stay null (never zero); source units (size_mn, margin_bps) preserved; reporting periods and issuer entity derived on the intake wire; RV currency codes validated. Not directly asserted: preservation of signs (negative values), currencies on ingested evidence, and definitions through extraction. Needs a fixture asserting sign/currency/definition text survives block extraction byte-for-byte (the over-wide-line test proves no character is dropped, but not these classes specifically).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Accept a structurally valid textless PDF and record the lack of a text layer
notes: A structurally valid PDF with no text layer is admitted (source-set v1) and the intake records it as disposition 'insufficient' with the typed INTAKE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT clarification while keeping the scan in the set (classify.py sets text_layer False / signal no_text_layer, which drives that disposition).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject malformed PDF structures and parser exceptions without partial state
notes: Malformed PDF bytes are 422 with no source-set delta; in a pack the malformed member refuses everything and leaves an existing case's set and current run unchanged; the smoke's refused pack creates no case. extract_blocks turns every parser exception into the typed 422 before any store write.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject active workbook content, external relationships, unsafe package parts, and formula execution
notes: Proven for the loan-universe (CP-3) importer only: externalLinks parts, external relationships, DTD-bearing parts and macro/vba content types are refused before parsing and formulas are never evaluated. The general XLSX source path (sources/domain.py extract_blocks) has no package screening beyond the zip traversal/bomb guards: an .xlsx carrying external relationships or unsafe parts is admitted as evidence. No retained test covers that path.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Treat an uncached spreadsheet formula as null, not as a calculated value
notes: Proven for the loan-universe importer (data_only load, formula cell -> null, never evaluated). The general XLSX source extractor loads data_only=False and emits the formula string as cell text; that is not a calculated value but it is not null either, and no retained test asserts either behaviour on that path. CLAUDE.md records the silent null import as an open product decision.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Exclude hidden sheets and columns when the contract requires visible evidence only
notes: Hidden sheets are excluded by the loan-universe importer (sheet_state != visible skipped; 'Hidden' rows never appear). Hidden columns are not handled anywhere (loan_universe.py checks sheet_state only) and no test asserts their exclusion; the general XLSX extractor iterates every worksheet regardless of visibility (no contract requires visible-only there).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Enforce row, column, sheet, line, source-byte, block-count, and total-text ceilings at exact boundaries
notes: Exact below/at/above proven for source bytes (in-process and over HTTP), manifest block rows and intake file count. Row and sheet caps are proven only above the (monkeypatched) ceiling; the column cap (MAX_XLSX_EXTRACT_COLUMNS) and the total-text ceiling are proven above only; the line ceiling is a split, not a refusal, proven for > MAX_BLOCK_CHARS but not at exactly MAX_BLOCK_CHARS. Add at-boundary admission cases for rows, columns, sheets, line width and total text.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject a source that would require truncation rather than ingesting a prefix
notes: Text over MAX_SOURCE_TEXT is 422 (never a prefix); an upload over max_bytes is 413 (the reader takes max+1 and refuses); XLSX over its row/sheet caps is 422; where a document is kept it is kept whole (split and grouped blocks re-join to the exact original text).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject archive traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, duplicate members, decompression bombs, nested archive bombs, and excessive member counts
notes: Proven over the wire: a PK-prefixed upload with a '../' member and a 20 MB/ratio decompression bomb are 422 (validate_archive: traversal, expanded size, ratio). Guards for absolute paths and member count exist in code but no test drives them; symlink members, duplicate members and nested archive bombs are not checked at all (the archive guard inspects one level of the zip directory). The test also asserts only the status, not the typed detail.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Run malware scanning when configured and fail closed when the scanner is unavailable in the enterprise profile
notes: In the production profile the configured clamd is contacted before any vault write and an unreachable scanner is a 503 naming the scanner with no source row and no vault byte (fail closed); the EICAR marker is refused at the helper, the source route and the intake; the scan runs after the size ceiling and before the vault. Weak point: the clamd 'FOUND' response path is exercised by no retained test (only the in-process EICAR marker and the unreachable path); the 'not configured' 503 branch is also untested.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Keep source roots immutable and store derivatives in a controlled workspace
notes: Source bytes are content-addressed under the vault: put() refuses to overwrite an existing digest with different bytes ('existing source identity mismatch'), verify()/read_source_bytes fail closed on tamper; withdrawal is a flag and the row stays retrievable; source-set membership is immutable and the pin never moves. Derivatives (blocks) live on the source row in the store, and the image carries only the tracked tree. Weak point: no test asserts a write-protection mechanism on the vault file itself, only that any change is detected and refused.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Verify source bytes before and after preparation
notes: Before: prepare_upload hashes the received bytes and Vault.put verifies the digest of what it writes. After: the gate node and acceptance re-verify vault bytes (AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH on tamper), the loan import re-hashes vault bytes against the source digest (RV_SOURCE_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH) and changed stored blocks without a new set are refused.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Preserve page, slide, sheet, row, cell, clause, and block locators through extraction
notes: Proven: line, line-range and line-part locators for text-shaped sources; {sheet, row} locators for the loan-universe importer, preserved through duplicate collapse. Not preserved by the extractor: PDF page locators (pages are joined with newlines and packed by line), XLSX sheet/row/cell locators on general sources (the '[sheet:name]' marker is a text line, the locator is a line number), clause locators; slides are not a supported type. No retained test asserts page, cell or clause locators.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Prove every prepared representation maps to one original source digest
notes: Blocks live on the source row keyed to its sha256 and any drift between stored blocks and the pinned digest is refused at acceptance and at model readiness; the normalized loan universe is a deterministic digest of the workbook bytes and is refused when vault bytes no longer match the source digest; delivered evidence rows carry source provenance.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Enforce one active content representation per retained logical source
notes: Identical active bytes are 409 until withdrawal; two concurrent identical uploads on independent PostgreSQL connections admit one active source and one set version; the loan universe keeps exactly one ACTIVE representation per case; in-pack duplicates collapse to one source id.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Keep every base legal document, amendment, waiver, and supplement separately active and linked
notes: Proven: a credit agreement and its amendment are both admitted 'used' in one set and the amendment is classified document_type 'amendment' / version_status 'amendment'. Not proven: no link to the base agreement is asserted or carried on the wire (DOCUMENT_KEYS has no base/link field despite the test name), and waivers and supplements have no fixture.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Collapse exact active duplicates without losing original names or locators
notes: The duplicate manifest row keeps its own filename and shares the original's source id (one source, both names); re-dropped members read 'duplicate' against the existing rows; workbook duplicates collapse to one instrument carrying every sheet/row locator.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject conflicting duplicates and identifier mappings with structured findings
notes: Same filename with different bytes is INTAKE_SOURCE_CONFLICT with one finding per file and nothing admitted; conflicting workbook duplicates and identifier mappings are RV_DUPLICATE_CONFLICT / RV_ID_CONFLICT findings that reject the candidate and preserve the prior active universe.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reupload withdrawn bytes as a new source identity and a later source-set version
notes: After withdrawal (set v2) the same bytes are admitted as a new source id at set v3 whose membership is only the new id; promotion after withdrawal mints a new identity rather than resurrecting the old row; interleavings on two PostgreSQL connections keep the version history monotonic.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Roll back source metadata, vault bytes, audit events, and source-set changes when any persistence step fails
notes: Proven: a failing audit write rolls back the source row, the source-set version and every audit row; a vault write that hits ENOSPC leaves no partial or complete file and no row; a refused pack admits nothing. Not met as written: when the store step fails after a successful vault write, the content-addressed vault blob is kept by design (Task 8 report: 'a blob without a row is not a source') and no test asserts its removal, so 'vault bytes' are not rolled back in that ordering.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Re-hash vault bytes before every governed use and reject corruption
notes: Engine._verify_source_vault re-hashes every pinned source's vault bytes at the gate node (pin) and again in _validated_plan_artifacts (acceptance), refusing AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH on mismatch; read_source_bytes refuses SOURCE_BYTES_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH; the loan import re-hashes before activation; model readiness refuses tampered stored blocks. Weak point: read_evidence serves stored blocks rather than re-reading vault bytes, so per-read re-hashing is indirect (block drift is caught by the digest checks above).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Prevent one case from reading or importing another case's source
notes: A read of another case's source id is AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH with no foreign text delivered even when the model obeys the document; importing another case's workbook is 404; intake into a foreign case is 404; the route audit drove 20 cross-case id probes with 0 failures.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Keep storage paths, scanner details, adapters, and internal metadata out of public responses
notes: vault_path/withdrawn_at never appear on upload, list or detail; the source wire is the exact pinned key set on a strict model; DB driver text (host, statement) never reaches the wire; provider adapter identity leaks no key. Scanner outage detail is the fixed string 'malware scanner unavailable' with no host/port (sim_028).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Treat every document instruction, link, macro, prompt, and embedded command as inert evidence
notes: A document instructing the host to change route/issuer is admitted 'used' with no effect on the route and its text never reaches the route reason; web-discovery and forged-contract instructions obeyed by the provider double are refused at the host; forbidden authority keys and smuggled envelope fields are refused; macro/active workbook parts are refused outright rather than executed.

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Normalize accepted pinned text to Unicode Normalization Form C after validation and within the stored length bound
notes: Two spellings of one issuer (NFD/NFC) store as one; U+0958 (expands under NFC) proves normalization runs before the 160-char bound (80 -> 160 stored, 160 -> 422); narrative text is NFC before the revision digest. Scope: applies to pinned analyst strings (case identity, notes, focus questions, deliverable blocks, loan-workbook cells); source document text itself is stored as extracted (recorded non-finding in SPEC_RECONCILIATION).

section: Test source intake and evidence preparation
condition: Reject control characters, lone surrogates, invalid byte strings, and bidirectional text that violates the display policy
notes: Lone surrogate and NUL refused by validate_boundary_text; \u0007 in case name and note body is 422 over HTTP; a lone surrogate in a focus question is 422 and not echoed; all nine bidi embedding/override/isolate controls are refused while Arabic/Hebrew text with directional marks passes; control bytes in deliverable blocks and citations are refused; invalid UTF-8 byte strings in text sources are refused at ingestion.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Create the source and source-set version in one atomic transaction
notes: An injected failure after the source insert leaves no source row, no source-set version and no audit row, and the retry mints version 1; two PostgreSQL connections admit one active source and one set version; a store outage before the write leaves no vault object, row or set.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Pin the exact source-set ID, version, member IDs, and member digests before analytical execution
notes: Gate exit pins source_set_id and source_set_version (asserted directly), source_set_digest over the six-field projection including source_ids (member ids; re-verified against the store record) and source_authority (per-member sha256 + blocks_digest, proven by the content-changed refusal). Nothing is pinned before the gate; the pin happens on resume before the first module. Weak point: no test enumerates plan['source_authority'] fields by name - member ids/digests are proven through the digest-expectation refusals rather than a field-level assertion.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Keep a running analysis on its pinned set when later documents arrive
notes: A document uploaded mid-run does not move the pinned set id; a later same-case source is refused AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH when read; a loan workbook imported or superseded after the pin never enters the run (the non-agentic channel).

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Refuse acceptance when the historical pinned set cannot be resolved
notes: The pinned set row is deleted after the run succeeds; acceptance raises SOURCE_SET_CHANGED. The digest expectation re-reads the store record by id and refuses a mismatch.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Reject withdrawn sources for every new note, assumption, model, report, citation, and run read
notes: Assumption save refuses EVIDENCE_SOURCE_WITHDRAWN (also on two PostgreSQL connections); every read_evidence re-checks withdrawal live; a run over a withdrawn pinned source fails closed and acceptance refuses; model readiness turns CANONICAL_MODEL_INPUTS_INVALID and a build cannot complete READY past a withdrawal; a deliverable freeze refuses a withdrawn citation. Notes carry no citations in this product - the 'note' half is covered only by a withdrawn promoted-note source never being resurrected (a re-promotion mints a new id).

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Preserve historical accepted work while marking dependent current work stale after withdrawal
notes: After withdrawal the case's accepted_snapshot_id is unchanged ('acceptance is history, not revoked') while model readiness, the registry read and citing assumptions turn STALE/invalid; the withdrawn source stays retrievable; withdrawal mints a new set version and leaves the pinned record intact.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Validate case, source-set membership, withdrawal state, source digest, and block identity on every `read_evidence` call
owner: engine owner (engine/evidence.py) with the decision owner
notes: Four of the five checks are proven per call: case binding, pinned-set membership, live withdrawal and (source_id, block_id) identity, across the 33-shape matrix. The source DIGEST is not re-verified inside EvidenceReader._authorized_source; it is re-verified per module attempt (Engine._live_plan_sources compares plan['source_authority'] with the live rows before the reader is built) and again at finalization/acceptance (content-changed and vault-corruption refusals). Missing: either a DECISIONS entry recording the per-attempt bracket as satisfying 'on every read_evidence call', or a per-read digest check plus a test that mutates a pinned source's blocks between two reads of one module and asserts the second read refuses.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Return no evidence text when any read check fails
notes: All 33 refusal shapes assert the exception chain, the delivered set and the ledger carry no evidence text; a refused read is never a tool_result (the module ends, nothing reaches the model); the persisted run error is {code, module_id}; the log line carries the code only.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Prohibit listing, searching, or reading unpinned case evidence from the model tool surface
notes: The model tool surface is exactly read_evidence (plus run_methodology_calculation where a module declares calculators): no list or search tool exists, an undeclared tool is refused by name before dispatch, and a read of a same-case source outside the pinned set is refused with no text.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Prohibit web, email, filesystem, shell, and arbitrary network evidence acquisition during a run
notes: Structural ban: the only evidence channel is the host read_evidence tool; any other tool call (web, email, filesystem, shell, network) is refused by name with AGENT_OUTPUT_INVALID and no repair; CP-1C is registry-pinned supplied_only, the tracked sources carry no external acquisition lane, and a Deep Research brief with source_mode 'hybrid' is refused before any row. No per-channel egress test (e.g. a network sandbox) is retained; the proof is the absence of any such tool.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Require every factual statement to cite at least one delivered evidence block or an approved deterministic result
owner: enterprise test owner (live credential) / model risk
notes: Host-enforced: evidence_refs min 1 per envelope, refs must equal the delivered set exactly, model-facing tables must carry returned source ids, fixed prose without model-facing attribution is refused. Per-STATEMENT citation is model behaviour; the retained proof is the harness 'unsupported_claims' dimension (every number in claim sections traceable to delivered evidence or a calculation output) passing on 32 cells under the answer-keyed host-control binding.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Require every numeric statement to retain value, unit, currency where relevant, period, entity, source, and locator
owner: enterprise test owner (live credential) / model risk
notes: The host carries value/unit/period/source/locator on the answer key and the delivered rows (source_id, source_digest, block_id, locator, extractor_version), and the 'facts' dimension links each expected fact (F1-F3 on C03, incl. value, unit, period, source) to a cited block; unsupported_claims traces every number. Partial even under host control: currency and entity are not independently scored, and the canonical envelope has no per-number schema - retention is asserted on markdown match strings.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance
condition: Reject fabricated, duplicate, foreign-case, withdrawn, unreturned, or malformed citations
notes: Proven: fabricated and unreturned evidence citations refused (declared set must equal the delivered set), undelivered/duplicate CALCULATION refs refused, malformed refs refused by the bounded EvidenceRef/CalculationRef schemas, withdrawn citations refused on assumptions and deliverables, foreign-case citations structurally impossible (the delivered set only holds authorized reads). Missing: no retained test feeds duplicate evidence_refs pairs to validate_citations/canonicalization and asserts the refusal - the branch exists (len(pairs) != len(set(pairs))) but is unpinned.

section: Test source sets, citations, and provenance

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Create a report draft from the accepted snapshot, approved template, and selected qualified model authority
notes: A draft composes from the accepted snapshot's verified artifacts (fails closed without accepted authority or on a forged artifact digest), the registry template, and a model selection that must resolve to the exact validated build or signed revision (MODEL_REVISION_STALE / MODEL_BUILD_STALE otherwise). 'Qualified' here means validated build or signed revision; live-model qualification of the underlying analysis is external (MOD family).

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Generate only template-declared machine blocks
notes: Only template-declared optional kinds, slots, caps and order are accepted (DELIVERABLE_SLOT_INVALID, DELIVERABLE_TEMPLATE_ORDER_INVALID), ungoverned metric ids and chart recipe fields are refused, and client-supplied document sections are a 422.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Validate every generated table and citation before it enters the draft
notes: Citations must resolve to same-case, existing, non-withdrawn blocks before a save appends; generated metrics, tables and scenario exhibits are rebuilt server-side from the pinned revision and refused on digest or calculation mismatch; accepted artifact bytes are re-verified at composition.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Keep analyst-authored opinion blocks distinct from generated fact and analysis blocks
notes: Analyst narrative and the opinion are ANALYST-origin, editable sections; generated fact and model sections are locked with MODEL/ARTIFACT origin; the origin labels survive into Markdown, PDF and XLSX (goldens) and the opinion leads the decision page.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Require analyst ownership of the external opinion and material overrides
notes: The external opinion exists only as a named analyst's signed record carrying opinion, limitations, material_overrides and rationale, bound to the exact revision; freeze and filing carry the signer. The material_overrides statement is required non-blank but no test links it to the concrete model overrides in the analyst revision.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Save drafts as append-only revisions using expected-version compare-and-swap
notes: Saves are content-addressed revisions appended under an expected-version CAS; racing saves yield one winner and one typed conflict carrying the committed head, on SQLite and on two PostgreSQL connections.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Reject stale saves without appending partial content or audit events
notes: The losing save appends no revision and no deliverable.draft.saved audit event (exactly one event per appended revision); a stale HTTP PUT is a 409 with the current revision embedded; an order violation appends nothing.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Preserve revision history after source withdrawal, model supersession, and later edits
notes: Later edits and restores are proven to leave prior revisions byte-identical. After a source withdrawal the tests assert only that sign-off and citation saves are refused (EVIDENCE_SOURCE_WITHDRAWN); after model supersession only that filing is refused (FROZEN_MODEL_AUTHORITY_STALE); neither reads revision_history back. deliverable_revisions has no append-only trigger test (the tamper test writes the row directly). Needs a test that withdraws a cited source and supersedes the model, then asserts the full history is still served unchanged.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Mark a draft stale when its accepted snapshot, source set, model revision, template, or methodology authority changes
notes: Snapshot, source-set and draft-revision changes are surfaced as a stale opinion state with typed reasons (ACCEPTED_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED, SOURCE_SET_CHANGED, DRAFT_REVISION_CHANGED) and freeze refuses; a moved model revision is a typed refusal at save, freeze and filing. Not covered: the draft itself carries no stale marker (staleness lives on the opinion state), and no test changes the template or the methodology authority under a draft (templates are static in the registry; runs pin the build). Needs a design call on the draft-level marker plus template/methodology staleness tests.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Require the analyst to resolve or acknowledge every material stale dependency before freeze
notes: Freeze is refused while any bound authority (draft revision, source set, accepted snapshot, model identity, methodology) is stale and succeeds only after the analyst re-signs on the current revision; an application-build fallback requires an explicit acknowledgement. Acknowledgement is the re-sign binding all authorities at once, not a per-dependency acknowledgement record.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Freeze the exact draft version, content digest, template, snapshot, model authority, and cited evidence set
notes: The frozen payload pins draft id/version/digest, template id and version, accepted snapshot and source set, model identity with the signed revision's outputs and assumptions verbatim, the methodology build id, the opinion, and the cited evidence set (payload['evidence'], asserted present in every format by the goldens); a tampered stored revision or a moved source set is refused.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Render Markdown, Portable Document Format, and spreadsheet files deterministically where the template supports them
notes: Six states render md/pdf/xlsx from one frozen payload and match identifier-normalised goldens; the same payload renders identical PDF bytes twice; every pathway renders all three formats; PDF glyphs come only from the digest-verified vendored DejaVu bundle; a divergent render for a published identity is DELIVERABLE_FREEZE_CONFLICT. The retained backend gate ran on the developer host, not inside the worker image, so on-image determinism is not retained for this candidate.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Verify rendered bytes and digest before recording a successful freeze
notes: The FROZEN record and deliverable.frozen event exist only after every export is published hash-addressed and read back with its digest and size verified; a retry after publish-but-before-commit converges on the same record. Exercised in-process through run_pending_freezes, not through the worker container on the image.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Prevent rendering failure from creating a frozen or filed record
notes: A renderer crash leaves a FAILED job with DELIVERABLE_RENDER_FAILED (message never persisted), no frozen record, no deliverable.frozen event and no half-published export; a missing export refuses filing and keeps the gate parked; a font bundle failing verification refuses to render.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Sanitize filenames and document metadata
notes: Export filenames are not user-derived: the deliverable export route serves bytes with x-caos-sha256 and no Content-Disposition, the audit package names itself from the server case id, and upload filenames are canonicalised at the source route ('../../escape.txt' -> 'escape.txt'). Document metadata (PDF Info dictionary, XLSX docProps creator/dates) is not asserted by any retained test beyond byte-determinism (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 pinned by the goldens). Needs a test reading PDF/XLSX metadata and, if a download filename is ever added, its sanitisation.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Prevent spreadsheet-formula injection in exported text cells
notes: An '=HYPERLINK(...)' narrative reaches the workbook as an escaped literal string (data_type 's'), no cell in any sheet has data_type 'f', and model numbers stay typed floats; the renderer also raises DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_UNSAFE if a formula reaches the workbook. The signed model export is asserted formula-free in the distressed overlay spec.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Prevent HTML, script, active-link, or Markdown injection in browser previews and exported files
owner: enterprise test owner (renderer and frontend injection tests)
notes: Code escapes Pango markup with html.escape (renderers._esc) and Markdown cells escape pipes; XLSX HYPERLINK formulas are neutralised; boundary text refuses control and bidi-override characters. No retained test injects <script>, <b>, javascript: or [text](url) into a narrative and asserts literal rendering in the PDF, Markdown, XLSX or the browser preview (DeliverableDocument.tsx); the workbench journey used fixture routes. Needs adversarial narrative fixtures across all four surfaces.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Inspect every page and sheet for clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, unreadable tables, broken page breaks, stale values, weak hierarchy, misaligned numerics, excessive density, and material inferiority to the pinned Credit Operating System benchmark
notes: The goldens pin page counts, heading order, a 1,000-8,000 character bound on every long-text page (no blank, heading-only or overprinted page), intact CJK/Greek/Turkish/ligature text and the vendored font bundle, but clipping, overlap, hierarchy, density and benchmark inferiority are visual judgments. The implementer's page-by-page inspection exists only as prose in the Task 10 report, not as a retained artifact for this candidate; the benchmark comparison (e566c1b) is REV-006 Q2, OUTSTANDING.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Require an approver with current case standing who is independent of the analyst/opinion signer and freeze actor, and prove the approver can be provisioned without direct database seeding
notes: POST /api/cases/{id}/members provisions an APPROVER over HTTP (analyst 403, reader 403, outsider 404 even as global ADMIN, invalid role 422) and that approver files; the opinion signer and the freeze actor are refused APPROVER_NOT_INDEPENDENT (403) even with approver standing; filing needs stored case APPROVER/ADMIN standing plus a current global writer role.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Bind approval to the exact preview digest and approval fingerprint
notes: Approval carries exactly preview_digest and input_fingerprint; a mismatch on either is refused and the record stays FROZEN and retryable; the gate hash is the canonical sha256:<preview_digest> form only; caller-owned authority fields are 422; the receipt records the bound digest, fingerprint and approval hash.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Reject approval after any byte, dependency, standing, or source-status change
notes: Bytes: tampered frozen content or substituted export metadata is refused. Dependency: a superseded snapshot, a forged accepted artifact, a newer active model revision, or an authority move mid-approval is refused inside the CAS. Standing: membership revoked between authorization and commit, or a downgraded global role, refuses at commit. Source status: a source-set change between freeze and filing is refused. Every refusal leaves the record FROZEN with no audit residue. A post-freeze withdrawal of a cited source is covered only through the source-set version it moves.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Emit one filed record and one filing audit event under concurrent approval attempts
notes: Two concurrent approvers yield one FILED record, one receipt and one deliverable.filed event, with the loser refused RESUME_NOT_APPLIED; proven in-process and on two PostgreSQL connections (SIM-017); a duplicate resume is a 409, never a second filing.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Download only the exact filed bytes and verify the digest again at read time
notes: Downloads serve the stored bytes whose sha256 and size equal the frozen record (never re-rendered, even by an instance whose renderer explodes); a tampered export is DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_INTEGRITY_FAILED (409) and a missing one DELIVERABLE_EXPORT_UNAVAILABLE, with no audit residue; served downloads are audited. Proven through the app's TestClient, not through the Caddy edge on the image.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Exclude internal prompts, provider traces, secrets, draft comments, hidden controls, and non-publishable notes from external files
notes: The packaged filed export bytes are scanned for source block text, vault paths, session/edge secrets, api_key/authorization, prompt/system_prompt/messages and found clean; the approver identity never appears in any format; renderers walk payload.publication only. Not asserted: exclusion of draft comments (a request-changes comment is appended to the replacement draft and no test freezes after it), hidden controls, case notes or other non-publishable notes, and provider traces beyond the identity disclosure. Needs a fixture seeding each of those and scanning md/pdf/xlsx.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Include required source, limitation, machine-assistance, analyst-opinion, approval-state, date, version, and digest disclosures; keep the post-freeze approver identity in an immutable detached filing receipt unless an intended approver was prebound
notes: Every format carries the source register and citations, limitations, machine-assistance line, analyst opinion and owner, approval state PENDING APPROVAL, as-of date, draft version and the draft/content digests and input fingerprint (asserted by the parity checks and pinned by the normalised Markdown golden); the approver identity lives only in the append-only detached receipt and the approved bytes are untouched by filing. No intended-approver prebinding feature exists, so the 'unless prebound' clause has no path. The fixture's as-of date renders 'Unavailable' because the seeded acceptance carries no date.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Prove an external reader can distinguish sourced facts, analyst opinion, assumptions, and limitations
notes: The mechanical half is proven: 'Analyst judgment' versus 'Locked · model/artifact/system' origin labels, limitations, the opinion and its owner, and source ids are present in Markdown, PDF and XLSX for six states, and effective assumptions ride the model appendix. Whether an external reader can actually distinguish them is REV-006 Q1 (clarity, source disclosure, limitations, terminology), OUTSTANDING.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Request changes without mutating the frozen artifact
notes: A change request moves the record to CHANGES_REQUESTED with the frozen exports unchanged byte for byte, appends a traceable replacement draft carrying the comment, requires an approver and a non-blank comment, and rolls back entirely on a revision conflict.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Preserve prior filed versions after a later revision or refiling
notes: A later filing marks the prior FILED record SUPERSEDED with superseded_by_id and terminalises its thread; the record and its content-addressed exports are never rewritten or re-rendered. The export route serves SUPERSEDED records, but no retained test downloads a superseded filed export after refiling.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Block direct external transmission from the MVP unless a separately tested enterprise connector is authorized
notes: No transmission surface exists: the 59 audited routes are case, source, run, model, deliverable and audit reads and writes, and export is a download. But absence is not asserted: the retained sec-audit artifact holds only the summary line, the OpenAPI walk pins no route inventory, and the upload-only tests ban inbound acquisition patterns, not outbound sending; no connector-authorisation policy exists to test. Needs a pinned route inventory test asserting no outbound side effect and a recorded decision on connector authorisation.

section: Test report authoring and external publishing
condition: Reconstruct each published statement and number from the frozen audit package
owner: decision owner (golden journeys on the frozen stack); independent reviewer (REV-012)
notes: In-suite contract proof: a stdlib-only verifier in a clean directory recomputes every manifest digest, the audit chain, frozen and receipt digests, and re-renders the Markdown export byte for byte from the frozen payload, convicting six tamper classes. Not run on the image for this candidate (no retained package or verifier run), and the package holds block digests rather than source text, so tracing each published number back to its source needs the retained sources — REV-012's exercise, OUTSTANDING.

condition: Record source upload, scan, extraction, preparation, relevance disposition, period/revision classification, deduplication, withdrawal, and promotion events
notes: Partial. Proven: source.ingested per admitted file (and case.created), intake.admitted with intake_id and source_count, intake.run_started, intake.refused with its code and no case, source.withdrawn exactly once under race. Not recorded as audit events anywhere in the store's vocabulary: scan, extraction, preparation, relevance disposition, period/revision classification and deduplication (a duplicate upload is a refusal that appends no audit row; test_store asserts the trail is unchanged). Promotion has no retained positive assertion (test_promotion_rolls_back_atomically_on_downstream_failure asserts only the rollback; note.promoted is pinned only as a synthetic wire shape in test_http_contracts_spec). Dispositions and period classification persist on the case_intakes record and the source rows (served and packaged) but not as events. Missing: audit rows, or a recorded decision that record fields suffice, for scan/extraction/preparation/disposition/classification/dedup, plus a positive note.promoted assertion.

condition: Record route compilation, plan digest, source-set pin, methodology build, profile, pathway, and depth
notes: Partial. Proven: the pinned plan carries the compiled route (nodes and dependencies, deterministic, matched to the pinned golden per pathway/depth), plan_digest kept outside the digested blob and re-asserted (tampering the pinned set is AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH), build_id == bundle.build_id, source_set_id/version pinned at gate exit and immovable, and pathway/depth on the run plan with the persisted route decision (selected_by, reason). Not proven: the profile. plan["profile_id"]/selection_id are read by the runtime into host identity but no retained test asserts they are recorded on a persisted run. Missing: an assertion that the run's pinned plan carries profile_id and selection_id.

condition: Record every model attempt with actual provider, model, adapter, request digest, response digest, usage, retry, repair, and terminal code
notes: Partial. Proven on persisted attempt rows: the provider identity (provider, model, adapter version, identity digest) on every generation row, observed_model as the provider returned it, a 64-hex response_digest, terminal rows carrying terminal_code, the scalar allowlist with truncation and the route-sized cap (terminal rows cap-exempt). Recorded by the loop but not asserted by any retained test on the row: request_digest, input/output token usage on the generation row (only ledger totals are asserted), provider_retry rows (retry_index) and repair_reserve rows. Missing: retained assertions that a generation row carries request_digest and usage, and that a timeout retry and a repair each append their attempt row.

condition: Record every evidence read without storing unauthorized text or secrets
notes: Partial. What is recorded per read is a run-wide counter pair on the budget ledger (evidence_reads += 1, evidence_bytes += serialized size) and, at canonicalization, citations validated against the in-memory delivered set; a refused read is logged by typed code with none of the document. No durable per-read record (which source and block ids each read returned, when, for which module) exists in the store, the run events or the logs, so the record half is not met; the no-text half is proven (33 refusal shapes leave no text in rows, exception chain or ledger; a refused read leaves no citation expectation). Missing: a persisted per-read row (source_id, block_ids, bytes, module, seq) and a test over it.

condition: Record canonicalization, validation findings, confidence inputs, artifact digest, and lineage
notes: The stored artifact is the canonical envelope: digest(payload) == artifact digest, and the envelope carries lineage, confidence and provenance under a strict bounded schema (findings counts bounded, undeclared fields refused). Validation findings are recorded as typed codes (terminal_code on the last attempt row, the run error code; a non-Passed qa_status is terminal) and for the model as readiness blockers (MODEL_SOURCE_LINEAGE_INCOMPLETE never READY). Lineage is recorded per artifact (lineage.upstream_digests differ between runs) and per build (source_lineage, one row per pinned source, changing when a source is removed while outputs do not). Caveat: confidence inputs (source_gate, qa_status, findings) are proven as envelope fields via the schema pin and the deterministic path; no retained test inspects the confidence recomputation inputs on a live agent artifact.

condition: Record budget reservations, actual usage, reconciliation, and remaining ceilings
notes: The run_budgets ledger persists limits, used, the in-flight reservation digest and the attempt ring. A reservation is recorded before any provider call (a failed reservation means zero calls), an unreconciled in-flight reservation survives a crash and fails closed on resume without re-spend, reconciliation commits the actual billed usage (used.output_tokens == 5000) before refusing the overage and clears the in-flight digest, reserve/reconcile/charge each apply exactly once under two-connection races, and budget.reserved/budget.reconciled log lines answer what a run has spent. The remaining ceiling is served as limits minus used from the persisted record rather than as a separate stored column.

condition: Record run pause, resume, failure, success, acceptance, snapshot switch, and upgrade linkage
notes: Partial. Proven: run.created/run.running/node.running/node.succeeded/run.succeeded on the per-run monotonic event log with one terminal event, run.paused at the plan-approval gate, run.failed carrying the typed code, snapshot.accepted audited inside the acceptance transaction with the provider identity digest (exactly once under race), and upgraded_from_run_id linking an upgrade to its origin. Not proven: the snapshot switch. test_misc_spec::test_newer_accepted_run_sets_switch_required_until_explicit_switch calls switch_visible twice but asserts only the view's switch_required flag, and snapshot.visible_switched is otherwise pinned only as a synthetic wire shape in test_http_contracts_spec. Resume is recorded as run.running; gate.resolved is a log line, not a run event. Missing: an assertion that switch_visible appends snapshot.visible_switched with the snapshot id.

condition: Record model build, preview digest, scenario parameters, analyst sign-off, revision, rebase, and export
owner: decision owner (audit of transient previews, scenarios and rebases)
notes: Partial and partly contradicted by design. Proven: model.build_ready is audited when a build reaches READY; model.revision.signed exactly once per signed revision (append-only, expected-head CAS, one winner under race) with a server-assigned monotonic authority order. Not recorded by design: previews, scenario/one-way/tornado calculations and rebase previews are deliberately transient and the retained tests assert the audit trail is unchanged by them, so preview digests, scenario parameters and rebases leave no audit row (the preview digest survives only as the identity a sign-off binds). Export: model.export.queued/succeeded/failed/downloaded are pinned only as synthetic wire shapes; no retained test asserts their emission. Missing: a decision whether transient previews/scenarios/rebases must be audited, and a positive test over the export audit rows.

condition: Record report generation, analyst edits, freeze, render, change request, approval, filing, and download
notes: Partial. Proven: deliverable.draft.saved per appended revision (report generation and analyst edits, none for a CAS loser), deliverable.opinion.signed per opinion, deliverable.freeze_queued then deliverable.frozen only after the worker's verified render (the frozen event carries the preview digest), deliverable.freeze_failed with the typed render code and no message, deliverable.filed exactly once on approval/filing with one receipt, and deliverable.exported on download with no residue on a refused download. Not proven: the change request. The only retained assertion on deliverable.changes_requested is its absence after a revision conflict (test_deliverables_spec::test_change_request_revision_conflict_rolls_back_frozen_and_thread_transition); no retained test asserts a successful request appends it. Missing: a positive assertion over deliverable.changes_requested.

condition: Attribute each event to machine, analyst, approver, administrator, worker, or system recovery
notes: Partial. Proven: every audit row carries a non-null actor, the strict wire model requires it, and retained tests assert analyst, approver and case-admin attribution on specific rows. Not met: run_events has no actor column at all, so machine transitions and startup recovery are unattributed in the durable log (recovery.* exists only as log lines); the worker's freeze render is attributed to the requesting analyst (the e2e asserts the deliverable.frozen actor is "analyst", not a worker); and no event carries an attribution category (machine/analyst/approver/administrator/worker/system recovery) since actor is a free-form subject string. The audit row rides the governed write's own transaction: an injected failure after the audit insert leaves no source, no source set, no promoted note, no snapshot, no pointer move and no audit row (acceptance rolls back snapshot, both pointers and audit as one unit), a refused duplicate appends nothing, and twelve concurrent governed writes extend one contiguous chain that verifies.

Duplicate terminal events: exactly one run.succeeded/run.failed after a normal run, after a crash in the commit gap and after fan-out failure reconciliation. Broken digest links: AUDIT_CHAIN_LINK_BROKEN, AUDIT_EVENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH and AUDIT_CHAIN_HEAD_MISMATCH convict mutate/insert/reorder/head tampering with the triggers disarmed. Impossible transitions: accepting a run whose node artifact is forged is RUN_NOT_READY, a stale or late resume is the typed RESUME_NOT_APPLIED, and every run-state event rides a conditional transition so zero rows updated mints no event.

condition: Preserve timestamp ordering and record monotonic durations separately from wall-clock time

An hour parked at a human gate accrues zero active time while host compute and finalization are charged by the monotonic bracket. Audit rows are ordered by chain_seq, not at. Durations are the ledger's active_minutes, a quantity separate from the ISO at timestamps on events and audit rows.
